File: .github/workflows/plan.yml
Line or code reference: lines ~1228-1255 (plan_self_check_state/observation calculation) and ~1260-1275 (needs_clarification decision)
Problem: Workflow computes and exports plan_self_check_state and plan_self_check_observation but never consumes them for the reopen-clarification decision or blocked-handling step. The reopen logic still relies exclusively on the legacy SELF_CHECK_REOPEN_CLARIFICATION (blocker count only).

ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
